rateLimits.note: "API keys have a rate limit of 600 requests per hour by default"; higher limits on request. A report of more than 10,000 rows is several requests (one per page of results): the guard counts the call, Plausible's 429 the rest.

provenance.notes: Read on 2026-11-10: 600 requests an hour per API key by default (more on request); the Stats API is a Business plan feature; a key reads only the sites of the team it was made for. A self-hosted Plausible sets its own limits (the figure is plausible.io's). The terms set nothing on caching or storage of the statistics, which are the site owner's own: unknown.
